chapter: San Francisco, the So Different Orchestra and Johnny
title: Size and location of the Portola Louvre cabaret
summary: Spikes describes the huge cabaret with a show of up to two hundred girls, three dance floors and an ice rink, in the basement at Powell and Market.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: You said there was a company of two hundred... performers?

I think they had about a hundred fifty...two hundred girls. Oh, they had a marvelous big show, and they had the biggest cabaret, I think, in the country, at that time, you know. They had two...three dance floors and then they had a iceskating rink in there and everything else.
I never heard that name before. It's Puh... ...de...la.,?
Portola! P-O-R-T-O-L-A Portola Louverie. It was in the basement.
How do you spell the Louverie? L-O-U-V-E-R-I-E?
L-O-U-V-R-E, I think it was. It was right on the corner of Powell and Market.
I know where that is--Powell and Market.
You know where the turn-around was? It was down in the basement there.
I think they have a subway station there now --the Bay Area Rapid Transit.
